name: Ayase (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ayase city emblem in yellow and navy: a yellow stylised character outlined in navy, like a ring with horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Ayase, a city in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1952.

features.role: Ayase city emblem — a yellow stylised character outlined in navy, like a ring with horizontal bars
